reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual comparison of the exact native source, enlarged source page 11 and targeted source panel, complete unchanged native RGBA raw, targeted native-resolution face/collar crop, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and unchanged naiwa mascot reference

entries.positive_observation: The dark olive-grey peaked cap retains a black visor, gold piping/cord and two separated gold front emblems. Hair remains covered, dark eyebrows are present, and the face has one restrained closed mouth with a smooth chin and no glasses, moustache or beard. The near-frontal upright pose, forward gaze, chest-up crop, bright central facial modeling and strong under-cap shadow remain. The dark olive uniform retains gold shoulder accents, two red collar patches with pale/gold detailing and one small pale-edged dark decoration at the throat. The rounded chin meets a short broad fitted collar without a stalk, clipping or cream bib. The complete dark tilted frame, opaque pale grey-beige photographic backing, overlapping cream note with two compact upper gray-mark rows and largely blank lower paper, and right-edge tab remain. Full white/cyan comparisons show no visible holes, lost backing or working-matte ring.
entries.alpha_decision: Accept the native RGBA transparent exterior outside the complete frame/note silhouette. Actual white/cyan/alpha inspection found no visible holes or missing backing; 252-254 alpha values were not used as a rejection shortcut. No source-alpha replacement was performed or needed.
entries.visible_limitations: The smallest cap, collar and throat insignia and all note lettering are too tiny to transcribe reliably at 65x67. Visible colors, placements, counts and the two-row compact upper-note footprint were checked without claiming microscopic identity.
